title: Written Expression: Error Identification
ringkas: Kesalahan paralel, kata sifat/keterangan, jamak, dan tense
goals: menemukan **bagian yang salah** dalam kalimat (Written Expression)
mengenali kesalahan **subjek–kata kerja, jamak, preposisi, paralel, dan kata keterangan**
menjawab satu soal dalam sekitar **30 detik**

lesson.text: Pada **Written Expression**, setiap kalimat memiliki empat bagian bergaris bawah yang ditandai (A) sampai (D). Satu bagian salah. Tugasmu memilih bagian yang salah itu. Di sini bagian bertanda ditulis dengan huruf dalam tanda kurung.

lesson.title: Cek empat bagian secara berurutan
lesson.text: Baca seluruh kalimat dulu untuk maknanya. Lalu periksa (A), (B), (C), (D) satu per satu terhadap daftar kesalahan di atas.

items: Cek subjek–kata kerja, jamak, preposisi, paralel, kata keterangan.
Strategi: baca utuh, lalu periksa tiap bagian.

practice.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The (A) number of students (B) are increasing (C) every year (D) in this city.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: She (A) has been (B) working here (C) from (D) 2015.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: (A) Despite of (B) the rain, (C) the match (D) continued.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The (A) informations (B) in this report (C) are (D) very useful.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: He (A) suggested (B) me (C) to read (D) more books.
practice.exp: Suggested that I read / suggested reading.

practice.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: (A) Although it (B) was raining, (C) but (D) we went out.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The (A) children (B) was playing (C) in the (D) garden.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: I (A) look forward (B) to meet (C) you (D) next week.
practice.exp: to meeting. Jawaban yang tepat: **(B) to meet**.

practice.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: Most of the (A) students (B) in my class (C) is (D) very hardworking.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: She (A) is (B) more taller (C) than (D) her sister.
practice.exp: taller. Jawaban yang tepat: **(B) more taller**.

practice.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The teacher (A) asked us (B) to not (C) talk (D) during the test.
practice.exp: not to talk. Jawaban yang tepat: **(B) to not**.

practice.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: He (A) drives (B) very (C) careful (D) on rainy days.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: There (A) is (B) many (C) reasons (D) for this decision.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: She (A) speaks (B) English (C) very good (D) now.
practice.exp: very well. Jawaban yang tepat: **(C) very good**.

practice.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The book (A) which (B) I bought (C) it (D) yesterday is interesting.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The (A) sooner you start, the (B) easier (C) is (D) it.

quiz.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: He (A) did not (B) went (C) to school (D) yesterday.
quiz.exp: did not go. Jawaban yang tepat: **(B) went**.

quiz.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: (A) During I was (B) walking, I (C) saw (D) an accident.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: My brother, (A) who (B) live (C) in Jakarta, (D) is a doctor.
quiz.exp: who lives. Jawaban yang tepat: **(B) live**.

quiz.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: We (A) discussed (B) about (C) the plan (D) yesterday.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The (A) price (B) of the tickets (C) have (D) increased.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: I (A) will (B) call you (C) when (D) I will arrive.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: She (A) enjoys (B) to swim (C) in the (D) morning.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: It is (A) important that he (B) arrives (C) on time (D) tomorrow.
